digest.component_or_area: CI artifact probe / import integrity check
propositions: The wheel-probe CI step only runs `import rebar` and entry-point help calls, missing subpackage import failures and scripts module resolution errors that require scripts/ on sys.path

A new deterministic import walk script must cover every rebar.* module via pkgutil.walk_packages and every top-level scripts/*.py file in isolated child processes, reporting all failures without early exit
Optional-dependency modules (rebar._mcp_auth, rebar.opcert_service.app, rebar.review_bot.app) must be skipped only when their declared dependency is absent; any other ImportError is a real failure
Scripts modules must be imported in isolated child processes with scripts/ and CWD stripped from sys.path to prevent one script's sys.path.insert from masking a sibling's missing insert
The import walk must be locally runnable (portability) via `python scripts/check_import_walk.py` and a make target, with no CI dependency
